headline: METALS CRASH: Gold Wipes All 2026 Gains, Silver −7.5%, After Jobs Report 2× Forecasts
snippet: Gold sank 3.9% Friday to $4,366/oz, erasing all of its 2026 price gains and hitting its lowest London auction price since the first trading day of the year, as May nonfarm payrolls came in at 172,000 — more than double the 85,000 consensus — reviving bets on a year-end Fed rate hike. Silver collapsed 7.5% to $68.29/oz, dropping below $70 for the first time since late March.

headline: MAJOR PORPHYRY FIND: DPM Metals Drills 713m at 2.52 g/t AuEq in New Bulgaria Discovery
snippet: DPM Metals (TSX: DPM) confirmed a new high-grade gold-copper porphyry system at Brevene South, 1 km from its operating Chelopech mine in Bulgaria, with hole EX_BRESPO_03 returning 713m grading 1.31 g/t Au and 1.16% Cu — including a 398m high-grade core at 1.48 g/t Au and 1.45% Cu from 1,487m depth. Five drill rigs are now active; a Commercial Discovery Certificate is targeted for September 2026.

headline: GOLD DETHRONES TREASURIES: ECB Confirms Precious Metal Is Now World's No. 1 Reserve Asset
snippet: The ECB's annual reserve asset report confirms gold now accounts for 27% of global central bank reserve assets, overtaking US Treasuries at 22% — the first such inversion in the modern era. ECB President Lagarde attributed the shift to sustained buying by China, India, Poland, and Turkey driven by geopolitical risk, with gold's sharp price appreciation also boosting its portfolio share.

headline: INFLATION COMING BACK? Money Metals: CPI at 3.8% Signals Fed Never Won the Fight
snippet: Money Metals analyst Mike Maharrey argues April's 3.8% CPI print marks the opening act of a second inflationary cycle, echoing the 1966–68 "false victory" before the 1970s price spiral. The structural forces that drove the 2022 inflation peak — fiscal expansion, energy supply constraints, deglobalization — were never resolved by the Fed's tightening campaign, and today's jobs shock only reinforces the case for owning hard assets.

headline: BONANZA SILVER: Aya Hits 5,100 g/t over 2m at Morocco's Zgounder — Continuity Confirmed
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) reported standout near-pit-depth intercepts from Morocco's Zgounder mine, including 1,867 g/t Ag over 6.0m with a 5,100 g/t Ag core over 2.0m, and 739 g/t over 10.0m in an adjacent hole. Results confirm strong silver grade continuity around and below the open pit; 9,250m of the 30,000m 2026 exploration program has been drilled year-to-date.

headline: DRILL BIT DOWN: Tower Resources Targets Untested 2.7km BC Gold Trend Near Kamloops
snippet: Tower Resources (TSX-V: TWR) has mobilized to begin drilling at Rabbit North near Kamloops, BC, targeting untested segments of the Thunder-Blue Sky mesothermal orogenic gold structure. Only 600m of the 2.7km trend has been drill-tested to date — every hole crossing the structure has returned a significant gold intersection — making the remaining 2.1km of untested strike a high-priority target.

headline: RARE EARTH EXPANSION: Apex Critical Metals Triples Rift Drill Program to 25,000m After $15M Raise
snippet: Apex Critical Metals (CSE: APXC) is expanding its 2026 drill program at the Rift Rare Earth Project in Nebraska from 8,000m to 22,000–25,000m after closing a $15.5M financing. The Elk Creek carbonatite complex hosts two distinct high-grade REO zones, including a NdPr-enriched horizon with NdPr content exceeding 30%; a maiden mineral resource estimate is targeted for H1 2027.

headline: CAMECO BUYS IN: $116M Cigar Lake Stake Lift Pushes World's Top Uranium Producer to 57%
snippet: Cameco agreed to acquire TEPCO Resources' 5% participating interest in the world's highest-grade uranium mine for approximately $115.75 million, lifting its Cigar Lake ownership to 57.418% when the deal closes in Q3 2026. The acquisition deepens Cameco's production exposure ahead of long-term contract deliveries starting in 2027, including a CAD $2.6 billion deal with India.

headline: COPPER TARIFF WATCH: Trump Locks In 50% Section 232 Rate; June 30 Refined Copper Decision Looms
snippet: President Trump signed a new Section 232 proclamation on June 1, taking effect June 8, maintaining a 50% flat tariff on copper articles while adjusting rates for industrial equipment imports through December 2027. A separate June 30 deadline requires Commerce Secretary Lutnick to advise whether to impose phased tariffs on refined copper imports of 15% starting 2027 and 30% starting 2028.

headline: NEVADA SILVER-GOLD: Excalibur Metals Hits 100m Broad Zone Open at Depth in Maiden Drill
snippet: Excalibur Metals' first drill hole at the Bellehelen silver-gold project in Nevada returned a 100.58m mineralized interval at Spyglass Ridge, including a high-grade core of 360 g/t Ag and 2.03 g/t Au over 1.52m. The hole terminated within the zone — mineralization remains open at depth — with four holes from the 10-hole, 3,122m program still awaiting assay.
